title: Merge sort time split bound
statement: Define $T(n)=61n\lceil\log_2 n\rceil+74(n-1)+4$, where the logarithmic factor is the least natural number $k$ such that $n\le 2^k$. For every natural number $n\ge2$, $$61n+70+T\!\left(\left\lfloor\frac{n+1}{2}\right\rfloor\right)+T\!\left(n-\left\lfloor\frac{n+1}{2}\right\rfloor\right)\le T(n).$$
